headline: On November 19, 1997: Columbia launched on STS-87
captionCards: Takao Doi became the first Japanese astronaut to conduct an EVA
First EVA from Columbia marked a milestone in international space missions
instagramCaption:
Columbia lifted off from Kennedy Space Center on November 19, 1997.

This was the 88th shuttle flight and 24th for Columbia.
It carried USMP-4, conducted two EVAs, and deployed SPARTAN-201.
For the first time, a Japanese astronaut, Takao Doi, performed an EVA from Columbia.

Its legacy lives on in international space collaboration and microgravity research.
